description: On the bed in front of you there’s a small black multi‑port USB hub with a black cable attached, and a short white USB connector plugged into one of the ports. The left hand moves in from the left to steady the hub as a left-hand object, while the right hand comes in from the right to pinch the white USB plug as a right-hand object, tugging it slightly upward and to the right as if adjusting or starting to remove it, then both hands release and hover away leaving the plug still near the port.
